name: THE ONE SHOT
overview: Daigo from comedy duo Chidori kicks off a groundbreaking project combining film and comedy. Gathered for the project are eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions. Each must write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent. The comedy masters compete in a tournament, voting for each other to decide whose short film was best. With their pride on the line, they have spent three months pouring everything they have into creating one-of-a-kind stories. With just "one gag," can they strike straight at the hearts of the audience? Who will be crowned the first-ever ONE SHOT Champion?
